summary: Frontend-only testing of La Cuisine de Jeanine React app completed. Core functionality working well including navigation, contact form, and content display. One critical mobile responsiveness issue identified with hamburger menu.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile hamburger menu button not visible on small screens despite having md:hidden class
ui_bugs.details: Button has display:none even on 375px viewport, preventing mobile navigation access

design_issues.issue: Mobile navigation inaccessible due to hidden hamburger menu
design_issues.impact: Users cannot access navigation on mobile devices

passed_tests: Home page loads with all sections (hero, clients, solutions, cuisine, why-us, CTA, footer)
Navigation between all pages using hash routing (/, /solutions, /a-propos, /contact)
Solutions page displays frigo connecté, plateaux repas, and prestations sections with images
About page shows histoire, vision, and exigence sections with images
Contact form contains all 6 fields: name, company, email, phone, need_type, message
Contact form validation working for required fields (name, company, email)
All navigation links functional in navbar and footer
French accented characters display correctly throughout the site
Footer displays correct contact info and navigation links
CTA buttons redirect correctly to contact and solutions pages
Hash routing working properly for GitHub Pages deployment
Form fields accept input and validate properly
Direct URL navigation works on all pages
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix mobile hamburger menu visibility - the menu button has 'md:hidden' class but is not showing on mobile screens (375px viewport). Mobile users currently cannot access navigation menu. The CSS responsive behavior needs to be corrected so the hamburger menu appears on small screens and the desktop navigation is hidden.

success_percentage.frontend: 85% - Major functionality works, mobile menu needs fix
